tldr: 台股高檔劇烈震盪，AI 權值股主導多空，資金轉進高股息 ETF 尋求防禦。
台積電 CoWoS 先進封裝仍供不應求，外溢訂單嘉惠封測業者，先進封裝續為關鍵主軸。
金管會強化壽險體質並引導資金投入公建，金融三業 2025 獲利創史上次高。

items.title_zh: 台股高檔震盪加劇，AI 權值主導、資金轉進高息 ETF 避險
items.title_en: TAIEX swings wildly as AI names steer the market, investors seek shelter in dividend ETFs
items.summary_zh: 台股近期高檔劇烈震盪，單日動輒千點上下成為常態，AI 權值股主導多空走勢。震盪中資金轉進高股息 ETF 尋求防禦，市場將大幅波動歸因於 AI 供應鏈股評價偏高，以及對美國科技股與政策消息的高度敏感。後續仍須觀察權值股台積電動向與國際資金進出，波動度短線料維持偏高。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index has swung sharply through early November, with intraday moves of over a thousand points becoming common as AI-chip leaders drove both rallies and sell-offs. Investors rotated into high-dividend ETFs as defensive shelters amid the turbulence, which reflects stretched valuations in AI supply-chain stocks and heightened sensitivity to US tech-sector and policy headlines.

items.title_zh: ETF 除息潮回流逾四百億現金，撐盤並鞏固散戶參與
items.title_en: ETF ex-dividend wave returns hundreds of billions in cash to the market
items.summary_zh: 台股 ETF 除息潮登場，多檔台股 ETF 合計發放逾四百億元現金股利，回流至數百萬受益人，單一熱門高息 ETF 一次配發逾二百億元。配息資金回流對盤面形成支撐，也鞏固散戶參與度；惟投信經理人提醒，指數短線仍可能維持高檔震盪格局，建議以具息收保護的標的分批布局。
items.summary_en: A wave of Taiwan equity-ETF ex-dividend dates has released hundreds of billions of NT dollars in cash distributions back to millions of beneficiaries, with one popular high-yield ETF paying out over NT$20 billion in a single round. The cash reflow offers support to the market and underpins retail participation, even as managers warn the index will likely stay in a high, choppy range.

items.title_zh: 台積電 CoWoS 擴產仍難滿足需求，封測業者接外溢訂單
items.title_en: TSMC CoWoS expansion still short of demand, OSAT players reap spillover orders
items.summary_zh: 台積電積極擴充 CoWoS 先進封裝產能，仍難滿足爆發的 AI 需求，外溢訂單讓 OSAT 封測業者持續受惠。分析估計 2026 年 CoWoS 月產能將朝 12 至 14 萬片推進，輝達包下過半，博通、超微緊隨其後。供不應求態勢延續，使先進封裝成為 2027 年前的關鍵投資主軸，相關封測、設備與材料供應鏈動能可期。
items.summary_en: TSMC's aggressive expansion of CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity still cannot meet surging AI demand, leaving spillover orders to benefit outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) players. Analysts estimate monthly CoWoS capacity will climb toward 120,000–140,000 wafers in 2026, with Nvidia booking more than half, followed by Broadcom and AMD. The persistent shortage keeps advanced packaging a key investment theme into 2027.

items.title_zh: 台積電下世代封裝藍圖成形，CoPoS 規劃嘉義廠量產
items.title_en: TSMC advances next-gen packaging roadmap beyond CoWoS
items.summary_zh: 除 CoWoS 外，台積電加速下世代封裝布局：已成功量產五倍光罩尺寸先進封裝、良率良好，並朝九倍、十四倍光罩開發，下一代 CoPoS 規劃於 2028 至 2029 年在嘉義廠區量產。此技術藍圖顯示台灣封裝生態系未來數年仍將是 AI 加速器供應鏈核心，可望帶動設備、材料與封測族群的中長期成長動能。
items.summary_en: Beyond CoWoS, TSMC is advancing next-generation packaging: it reported successful mass production of five-reticle-size advanced packages with good yields and is developing nine- and fourteen-reticle designs, while CoPoS is slated for volume production around 2028–2029 at its Chiayi fabs. The roadmap signals Taiwan's packaging ecosystem will remain central to AI accelerator supply for years.

items.title_zh: 金管會三面向強化壽險體質，引導保險資金投入公建
items.title_en: FSC pushes to strengthen insurers and channel funds into public construction
items.summary_zh: 金管會推動三面向強化壽險業體質，同時引導保險資金投入國內公共建設。政策目標是在新一代清償能力制度上路前，提升壽險公司的資本適足與資產負債管理，並將長期資金導向公建。此舉兼顧審慎監理與支持國內投資，盼在穩健經營與活絡實體經濟間取得平衡，對壽險業資金運用與公建題材具中長期影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission is pressing a three-pronged push to strengthen life insurers' financial resilience while channeling insurance funds into domestic public infrastructure. The policy aims to improve solvency and asset-liability management ahead of new capital standards, while directing long-term capital toward public construction—balancing prudential safety with support for domestic investment and the real economy.

items.title_zh: 金融三業 2025 獲利 9,880 億創史上次高，金管會重申安全與發展並進
items.title_en: Three financial sectors post near-record 2025 pre-tax profit as FSC stresses "safety and development"
items.summary_zh: 金管會高層指出，台灣金融三業（銀行、保險、證券）2025 年稅前合計獲利 9,880 億元，為史上次高，主委重申「安全與發展並進」的監理方針。亮眼獲利為金融業提供吸收市場波動的緩衝，主管機關則持續強調資本強度與審慎風險管理。穩健獲利與趨嚴監理並行，有助金融股基本面，惟須留意利率與市場波動對投資收益的影響。
items.summary_en: The FSC's leadership highlighted that Taiwan's three major financial sectors—banking, insurance and securities—earned a combined pre-tax NT$988 billion in 2025, the second-highest on record, with the chairman reiterating a dual mandate of "safety and development." Strong profitability gives the industry a cushion to absorb market volatility, while regulators keep emphasizing capital strength and prudent risk management.

items.title_zh: 高息 ETF 00939 領跑 2026 績效，防禦特性受青睞
items.title_en: High-dividend ETF 00939 leads 2026 performance, prized for defense
items.summary_zh: 在台股高息 ETF 中，統一台灣高息動能(00939)以約 80% 的含息報酬率居 2026 年績效之冠（統計至 10 月底），領先國泰永續高股息(00878)等同類。經理人認為高息族群評價相對親民、現金流穩定且具防禦特性，對追求息收的存股族與高資產族群具吸引力，適合在高檔震盪行情中作為核心配置之一，惟仍須留意成分股評價與填息狀況。
items.summary_en: Among Taiwan's high-yield ETFs, UPAMC Taiwan High Dividend Momentum (00939) led 2026 performance with a total return near 80% (to late October), ahead of Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) and peers. Managers argue high-dividend names offer reasonable valuations, steady cash flow and defensive traits—attractive to income-oriented and high-net-worth investors navigating a choppy, high-level market.

items.title_zh: 11 月除息潮每單位配息走升，強化息收吸引力
items.title_en: November ex-dividend round lifts per-unit payouts
items.summary_zh: 11 月迎來新一波 ETF 除息：高息指標 00939 本次每單位配 0.15 元，較前幾個月的 0.125 元增加，並為去年同期 0.072 元的兩倍多；00878 預定 11 月 17 日除息。每單位配息走升，強化高息 ETF 在財富管理組合中的息收吸引力，惟實際配發金額與除息日仍以各投信正式公告為準，投資人宜將填息能力與整體資產配置一併評估。
items.summary_en: November brings a fresh round of ETF ex-dividend events: a leading high-yield ETF (00939) is paying NT$0.15 per unit, up from NT$0.125 in prior months and more than double the year-earlier NT$0.072, while 00878 is scheduled to go ex-dividend on November 17. Rising per-unit payouts reinforce the income appeal for wealth-management portfolios, though actual distributions follow each issuer's formal announcement.
